moat_type: Leading-edge semiconductor technology and manufacturing expertise
primary_risk: Dependence on a few large customers
sector_survival_note: The semiconductor industry is highly competitive and subject to rapid technological change, which may lead to disruption and replacement of market leaders.
thesis_summary: AMD's leading-edge semiconductor technology and manufacturing expertise ride the big trend of increasing demand for computing power and artificial intelligence.
thesis_breaks_if: A structural change in the company's business model or a significant disruption in the semiconductor industry.
sentiment_note: Richly valued but still a great company with a strong moat.
ten_k_highlights: The company's revenue has been rising at an average annual rate of 10.8% over the past five years.
The company's gross margin has been stable at around 53% over the past eight years.
The company's research and development expenses have been increasing at an average annual rate of 20% over the past five years.
valuation_note: FCF yield 1.0%, PEG 1.3, EV/EBITDA 118, P/S 24 — very richly valued — starter position only.
